# Psalm 96 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Sing to-YHWH a-song new; sing to-YHWH all the-earth.

**2** Sing to-YHWH, bless his-name; proclaim from-day to-day his-salvation.

**3** Declare among-the-nations his-glory, among-all the-peoples his-wonders.

**4** For great YHWH and-praised greatly; fearsome he above-all gods.

**5** For all gods-of the-peoples nothings, and-YHWH the-heavens made.

**6** Splendor and-majesty before-him; strength and-beauty in-his-sanctuary.

**7** Ascribe to-YHWH O-families-of the-peoples, ascribe to-YHWH glory and-strength.

**8** Ascribe to-YHWH the-glory-of his-name; bring an-offering and-come to-his-courts.

**9** Bow-down to-YHWH in-splendor-of holiness; tremble before-him all the-earth.

**10** Say among-the-nations, 'YHWH reigns!' Also is-established the-world not it-will-be-moved; he-will-judge the-peoples with-equity.

**11** Let-be-glad the-heavens and-let-rejoice the-earth; let-thunder the-sea and-its-fullness.

**12** Let-exult the-field and-all that-is-in-it; then will-sing-for-joy all trees-of the-forest,

**13** Before YHWH for he-comes, for he-comes to-judge the-earth; he-will-judge the-world in-righteousness, and-peoples in-his-faithfulness.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **96:5**: Hebrew elilim ('nothings/worthless') — a wordplay on elohim ('gods'); pagan deities are 'non-gods.'

- **96:11-13**: Creation praise: heavens, earth, sea, field, trees — the entire cosmos celebrates YHWH's coming judgment, understood as restoration, not destruction.

— EMET
